summary: Corrected F1-F3 in migrate.py. F1: per-op_id intent files; each apply unlinks only its own; the retry picks the newest unfinished confirmed intent. F2: the intent is rewritten with the bridge's real answer rows right after an applied answer and marked confirmed; only confirmed intents are used for recovery, so a plan-time action is never written. F3: a failed rollback removes a lock-only directory at the old path before renaming back, and keeps staging and raises MIGRATION_FAILED naming it when any folder cannot be restored. Added RecoveryTests (4 tests) to tests/test_migrate.py; tests.test_migrate passes (59 tests).
